answer: Require every AI agent to lock a refundable bond before it can earn fees or vote, with the bond sized to its expected influence. Random audits test whether identities behave independently; correlated coordination, duplicate credentials, or failed challenges trigger slashing, while honest reporters receive part of the penalty. A Sybil attacker therefore must fund and risk substantial collateral for every fake identity, even when its agents discuss an island, basalt, or marble.
